annotations.title: Buy a dossier from your wallet (charges €2)

description: BUY the full dossier for one entity programmatically — no browser, no Stripe Checkout. Debits your prepaid wallet €2 and returns the complete premium dossier (full UBO chain, filed financials, itemised assets, provenance) in the SAME response. Requires a funded API key (set WHITEINTEL_API_KEY). Idempotent per (buyer, entity): buying the same entity again returns it with NO second charge, so a retry is safe. If the wallet balance is too low you get a structured payment_required result with a top-up URL — a human tops up once at whiteintel.dev/pricing, then you retry and spend from the balance. Get the id from search_entities / resolve. This is the AGENT-NATIVE purchase path; buy_dossier is the human/browser (Stripe Checkout) path.
name: purchase_dossier
